title: Survival Sickness
description: Survival Sickness adds a deeper survival health system to Minecraft. Players can catch diseases from bad weather, mobs, unsafe food, desert heat, freezing, low sleep, wounds, and underwater strain.
body:
Survival Sickness

Survival Sickness adds a deeper survival health system to Minecraft. Players can catch diseases from bad weather, mobs, unsafe food, desert heat, freezing, low sleep, wounds, and underwater strain.

To survive, you must prepare medicines, collect medical ingredients, use the Medicine Mixer, and trade with Doctor villagers.

This mod is made for survival, hardcore worlds, and multiplayer servers where health management should feel more meaningful.

Features
10 survival diseases
Disease stages and symptoms
HUD disease icons
Screen effects for some illnesses
Cough, sneeze, and symptom sounds
Medicine Mixer workstation
Custom medicines and ingredients
Doctor villager with medicine trades
Raw Crystal Ore world generation
Crystal Salt smelting system
Custom ingredients found in village, shipwreck, and ruined portal chests
Multiplayer disease spread between nearby players
Server-friendly survival gameplay
How To Start

Start your world normally. Collect wood, food, stone tools, and basic resources.

As you explore, collect medicine ingredients from crafting, mining, and loot chests. You will need these to prepare medicines later.

Useful early items to collect:

Kelp
Wheat Seeds
Bone Meal
Charcoal
Flint
Honeycomb
Brown Mushroom
Glow Lichen
Moss Block
Vine
Rooted Dirt
Cactus
Blue Orchid
Azure Bluet

You can also find custom ingredients inside:

Village chests
Shipwreck chests
Ruined portal chests
Raw Crystal Ore and Crystal Salt

Crystal Salt is an important medical material used for medicine crafting and the Medicine Mixer.

To get Crystal Salt:

Mine Raw Crystal Ore underground.
Get Raw Crystal from the ore.
Smelt Raw Crystal in a furnace.
Receive Crystal Salt.

Raw Crystal Ore has two variants:

Raw Crystal Ore
Deepslate Raw Crystal Ore

Best mining level:

Y 16

Good mining range:

Y 0 to Y 32

Full generation range:

Y -24 to Y 56

Raw Crystal Ore generates in the Overworld with iron-like underground generation.

Medicine Mixer

The Medicine Mixer is the main workstation used to create medicines.

To use it:

Place the Medicine Mixer.
Add Medical Catalyst as fuel.
Add a Clean Water Bottle.
Add the correct two medicine ingredients.
Wait for the mixing progress to finish.
Take the finished medicine from the output slot.

One Medical Catalyst gives fuel for multiple medicines.

Medicines are made inside the Medicine Mixer, not in the crafting table.

Important Crafting Recipes
Clean Water Bottle
Water Bottle + Kelp = Clean Water Bottle
Medicinal Herb
Wheat Seeds + Bone Meal = Medicinal Herb
Mint Leaf
Fern + Bone Meal = Mint Leaf
Ginger Root
Rooted Dirt + Bone Meal = Ginger Root
Silverleaf Flower
Azure Bluet + Bone Meal = Silverleaf Flower
Blue Aloe Flower
Blue Orchid + Cactus = Blue Aloe Flower
Swamp Moss
Moss Block + Vine = Swamp Moss
Cave Fungus
Brown Mushroom + Glow Lichen = Cave Fungus
Charcoal Powder
Charcoal + Flint = Charcoal Powder
Honey Extract
Honeycomb + Sugar + Glass Bottle = Honey Extract
Bandage Cloth
String + White Wool = Bandage Cloth
Crystal Salt
Smelt Raw Crystal in a furnace = Crystal Salt
Medical Catalyst
Crystal Salt + Charcoal Powder + Cave Fungus = Medical Catalyst
Medicine Recipes

All medicines are prepared inside the Medicine Mixer.

Fever Tonic

Cures Fever.

Clean Water Bottle + Ginger Root + Medicinal Herb
Cold Syrup

Cures Cold.

Clean Water Bottle + Mint Leaf + Honey Extract
Cough Syrup

Cures Cough.

Clean Water Bottle + Mint Leaf + Medicinal Herb
Flu Remedy

Cures Flu.

Clean Water Bottle + Ginger Root + Silverleaf Flower
Pain Relief Tablet

Cures Headache.

Clean Water Bottle + Silverleaf Flower + Crystal Salt
Muscle Balm

Cures Leg Pain.

Clean Water Bottle + Blue Aloe Flower + Honey Extract
Breathing Elixir

Cures Respiratory Issue.

Clean Water Bottle + Swamp Moss + Crystal Salt
Digestive Medicine

Cures Diarrhea / Digestive Illness.

Clean Water Bottle + Charcoal Powder + Ginger Root
Antibiotic Mix

Cures Infection.

Clean Water Bottle + Cave Fungus + Bandage Cloth
Warmth Potion

Cures Frostbite.

Clean Water Bottle + Ginger Root + Charcoal Powder
Diseases

Diseases build up from survival conditions. Most diseases give warning messages before becoming active.

Disease	How You Get It	Cure
Cold	Rain, wet exposure, cold conditions	Cold Syrup
Cough	Rain exposure, slime exposure, nearby sick players	Cough Syrup
Flu	Witch exposure or nearby sick players	Flu Remedy
Fever	Desert heat, husks, overheating	Fever Tonic
Headache	Lack of sleep, heat and hunger	Pain Relief Tablet
Leg Pain	Sprinting too much	Muscle Balm
Respiratory Issue	Repeated diving, low air, drowned exposure	Breathing Elixir
Diarrhea	Rotten flesh, unsafe food, witch exposure	Digestive Medicine
Infection	Zombies, spiders, cave spiders, low-health wounds	Antibiotic Mix
Frostbite	Freezing, powdered snow, stray exposure	Warmth Potion
Doctor Villager

Villagers can become Doctors when a Medicine Mixer is nearby.

How to get a Doctor:

Place a Medicine Mixer near a villager.
Wait for the villager to become a Doctor.
Right-click the Doctor with an empty hand.
The Doctor can diagnose your sickness and offer medicine trades.

Doctors are useful when you do not have the ingredients to prepare medicine yourself.

Loot Chest Support

Custom medical items can also appear in loot chests.

Village chests may contain:

Medicinal Herb
Ginger Root
Mint Leaf
Bandage Cloth
Blue Aloe Flower
Silverleaf Flower
Raw Crystal
Crystal Salt
Medical Catalyst

Shipwreck chests may contain:

Clean Water Bottle
Swamp Moss
Mint Leaf
Raw Crystal
Crystal Salt

Ruined portal chests may contain:

Raw Crystal
Crystal Salt
Medical Catalyst
Cave Fungus
Charcoal Powder
Survival Tips
Mine around Y 16 to find Raw Crystal Ore.
Always keep Clean Water Bottles ready.
Carry Medical Catalyst when exploring.
Prepare Fever Tonic before desert travel.
Prepare Warmth Potion before snowy biome travel.
Prepare Breathing Elixir before ocean exploration.
Prepare Antibiotic Mix before cave exploration.
Sleep regularly to avoid Headache.
Avoid standing too close to sick players on multiplayer servers.
Milk does not properly cure diseases. Use the correct medicine.
Multiplayer / Server Info

For best results:

Server: required for disease mechanics, medicine crafting, Doctor villagers, trades, and world generation.
Client: recommended for HUD icons, GUI visuals, sounds, and screen effects.

This mod works well for survival servers, hardcore worlds, and roleplay-style survival gameplay.
